name: Hawks, eagles & owls
description: The diurnal and nocturnal raptor guild - the peregrine falcon, the buzzard-eagle aguila mora (Geranoaetus melanoleucus), hawks (Buteo ventralis, Geranoaetus polyosoma), harriers, falcons, and the owls tucuquere, lechuza, nuco and concon. Functional group pooling 14 source nodes (14 native, 0 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); rodents, passerines, insects, reptiles and rabbits are their shared prey, and the source even records a hawk taking the chimango caracara (tiuque, pooled here).
